name: dx_env
summary: DX-style rate/level envelope: 4 rates + 3 levels, all 0..99 (the Yamaha scale), exponential one-pole per stage (attack → decay1 → decay2 → sustain → release). Q15 gain out. The rate is a one-pole coefficient from `fm1_rate_coeff[rate]` (a non-uniform Yamaha-style curve: 99 = instant ≈ 0.73 ms, 0 ≈ 7 s, ~5% finer per step at the slow end), a `rate_scale` control input (default unity) scales it, velocity → envelope rate, `k` (key-follow) and `vk` (velocity-follow) factors (Q15) push the rates toward 0 (slower) / 99 (faster). Levels are total-level 0..99 → Q15 gain via `fm1_level_gain` (0.25 dB/step: 99 = max, 50 ≈ −12 dB, 0 = silence). A `trigger` event (default `voice_trig[v]`) resets to attack on every note-on edge, even mid-note (voice steal).
